rationale: Clear motor-vehicle collision with vehicle totaled and policyholder injury sustained in the accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday at a red light. The vehicle is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat; the other driver was traveling at ~35 mph and did not brake. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report and other driver's insurance information are available.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other driver traveling ~35 mph, did not brake

rationale: A tree fell on the policyholder's parked vehicle, causing hood and windshield damage—a textbook comprehensive auto claim.
claim_summary: Maple tree fell on policyholder's parked vehicle during high wind last night, damaging the hood and windshield. Comprehensive auto coverage applies with $1,000 deductible. Vehicle appears drivable but requires inspection to assess full damage extent and obtain repair estimate.

case_facts.description: maple tree fell on parked car in wind
